notes.title: Devlog V: Dungeons & Denarius
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Romans![/b]
During your journey through the lands of Romestead you'll come across remnants of the old empire. Dungeons, ruins, and more are dotted throughout the landscape, with treasure for you to reclaim. 
In this post we talk about the different types of dungeons you'll encounter, how they work, and what you can expect from entering one.

[h1]Dungeon Types[/h1]
As of the time of writing, there are currently two (technically three) different types of dungeons you will encounter. Dungeons, challenge dungeons, and boss dungeons. 
[h2]Dungeons[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/48f7a2d271de19f9e3ef8456d8b51016f8c792f5.png[/img]
"Regular" dungeons are usually big and consists of multiple connected rooms and enemy varieties. They are designed with a purpose, often aiming for environmental storytelling to some capacity. 

These dungeons are not randomly generated, and will usually have a set name hinting at what you can find inside. Stop the fallen protecting an altar of Orcus, infiltrate and interrupt a cruel satyr ritual, or explore the remnants of a mysterious volcanic workshop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/f0a04374d56b977805382e9d0c02af1cbb6dccb5.gif[/img]
These dungeons also have a chance to drop unique loot unique to them, like the Sacrificial Dagger from the Altar of Orcus. 

[h2]Challenge Dungeons[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/20b41dc50f98a3b317a1e21748d2e1d815f97276.png[/img]
Challenge dungeons, much like regular dungeons, can be found across the world, but works a bit differently. As you can tell from the name, challenge dungeons are intended to provide a more difficult experience. 

Where normal dungeons allow players to rest and exit at any point, challenge dungeons requires you to stop and consider "will I be able to take on the next room?". 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/3b4ab7e84c2c3438c55ab8a550df52fdf67a1f8f.gif[/img]
Each challenge dungeon consists of several rooms that you go through one at a time. Room design, destructible objects, and enemy placements are randomized, so each room will have a new experience - one that gets harder for each room progressed.
When you enter a challenge dungeon, all exits will close - trapping you in the room until every enemy inside is dead.

But greater risk brings greater reward! Glimmering treasure awaits those who braves the waves of enemies!

[h2]Boss Dungeons[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/d19ed2cb0c03e08500e8a9f63b88f49d1819e449.png[/img]
The third type is a special one you'll only encounter a few times, for these are the dungeons that hold a boss inside them. What bosses they are, you will discover in time. 

[h1]What We Are Working On[/h1]
The next chunk of content being added is going to be a big one, so there's lots going on behind the scenes! Listed below are but a few of the things brewing:
[list]
[*] [b]A new boss[/b] - Tremors shake the ground as a new challenge arrives to the world.
[*] [b]A new type of enemy[/b] - strange robed figures, each devoted to a different god, have begun to appear across the world.  
[*] [b]New buildings, upgrades, and resources[/b] - With new bosses comes new levels of progression, and that includes more ways to upgrade and expand your towns!
[*] [b]Citizen Quests[/b] - Want to increase your citizens loyalty to you even further? Why not help them out with some errands?
[*] [b]New character creation options[/b] - We're adding some missing visuals to character creation, as well as some new ones!
[/list]

[h1]We Are Legion[/h1]
As of today, Romestead has reached over [b]100,000 wishlists![/b] 
A massive thank you to everyone for your support and interest in Romestead and all it has to offer! We can't wait to show you all the things to come!

Until that time,
Roma Aeterna!

- the Beartwigs Team

notes.title: Devlog IV: The City Must Survive
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Romans![/b]
We're currently testing town raids in Romestead, so this week we’ll dedicate the devlog to taking a dive into how it works, and what you can expect from the future. We also take a moment to talk about feedback regarding the first few steps in Romestead.

[h2]Hold the Door![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/a6d99bb7624ecd6db3b56e9dae917c43e4ba80e6.gif[/img]
The town raids of Romestead will occur every few days, as the mysterious forces behind Rome's fall test your defences. That, or they just want to take your stuff.  

Once the message appears in your chat window, you'll have a bit of time to run back home before the raid begins. The raids are set to last for a few minutes, during which you'll have to use all the tools in your arsenal to fight off the incoming hordes. 

You'll have a set amount of time to repel the invaders. Failing to do so, or skipping the raid by sleeping through the night will result in a successful raid, causing lasting effects on your town.

[h2]No Cost Too Great[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/98c4d6a96a3d3e2909fa3a63f1d22266fda6e370.gif[/img]

If the worst comes to pass, your town can lose resources, citizens can suffer lasting wounds, or even worse. Die. 
To see a summary of rewards or consequences, you can open and view a "Town Report" page, that will detail what resources you lost (if any) or what citizens sadly didn't make it through the night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/07823a5daec4ff6cbc24e0c863ddfc3b6605e3e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/d354807ae724c9444bb81fe35bb1198682163911.png[/img]

While your building keeps its upgrade, when a citizen dies they are gone forever, and any levels they had are lost. So make sure you protect them well! 

[quote=Bridget] I would die to protect each and every citizen of this New Rome. For without them, I would be lost in the wilderness, surviving only on what I can forage and loot. Without them, there is no New Rome. 
-Bridget, Discord Citizen [/quote]

[h3]Not All Doom and Gloom[/h3]
If you feel the dangers are too great to handle alone, fear not!
While not in the game yet, you will eventually be able to construct a barracks, intended to let you get aid from your own citizens in combat.

We also added the possibility to give gifts to your citizens in order to increase their loyalty. Their personalities dictates what they like, so make sure to speak with them to get an idea of how to best serve your people!

[h2]The Watchers on the Wall[/h2]
While your citizens rely on you to save them when larger hordes of enemies arrive, they'll do their best to defend the town during the night when you are out adventuring.

When you build your town, every fortification counts. Walls, traps, ballista, everything has a "defence value" as can be seen in the workbench. You can also view your towns total defence value in the Town Core. 
The higher the better! This value is what determines how well your citizens will do without you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/82ca0e3b78bb64e4dc83f82407d26b175f4d95de.png[/img]

Much like the town raids, you can read a report every day about what your citizens are up to. Here you can see if they've leveled up, and if they've repelled any invaders during the night.

[h2]About The Romestead Tutorial[/h2]
Thanks to all you testers, we've received tonnes of excellent feedback regarding many various aspects of Romestead. One of the points that is unanimously mentioned, is getting started in the game. The tutorial, and the steps required to get into the game are poorly explained, vague, or nonexistent.

We are currently actively working on making the game easier to understand, as well as making the tutorial more extensive and better explained in order to make the initial steps into the world smoother. Thank you to everyone who's submitted feedback and ideas regarding this so far!

If you have access to the playtest, and want to submit your own feedback, please do so in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3493250/discussions/3/]playtest application forums, found here![/url]

At the moment the scope of testing is ranging up to the first boss, as well as a little bit beyond and around that. We're testing multiple biomes, enemies, and dungeons that you'll come across later in the game, as well as items, armours, and weapons.

[h2]What We're Working On[/h2]
Seeing all the new towns being built, strategies being formed, and bosses biting the dust invigorates us all with energy! Here's some things currently in the works!
[list]
[*] [b]Tutorials[/b] - As mentioned above, we're hard at work making the onboarding process a smoother experience for you all.
[*] [b]New Buildings[/b] - New buildings and constructions are constantly being added to the game, be it new roads or a new type of resource gathering building!
[*] [b]New Enemies[/b] - New foes lie in the shadows, waiting to strike when you least expect it. This one uses a type of damage no other enemies do... magic.
[*] [b]New Crops / Items[/b] - Much like buildings and enemies, new items and crops are always being added to the game. Introduced in one of the most recent patches were mint and bay leafs, mainly used for cooking.
[/list]

[h2]Until Next Time[/h2]
We hope you're as excited as we are to gear up and defend your town from evil.
We will be back in two weeks with more information and behind the scenes!

Until then,
Roma Aeterna

- the Beartwigs Team

notes.title: Devlog III: Ancient Arsenal
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Romans![/b]
With the playtest fast approaching, we're covering some of your options when fighting to defend your new empire.

[h2]To Arms![/h2]
You already know about the favor system and what it can do.
But what would a shield bash be without a shield? 
Have a look at some of the weapons you can expect to encounter and craft on your journey.

[b]Gladium[/b]
The old trustworthy. A weapon capable of keeping several enemies at bay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/922fd0aaa471ffc4538e8077192197606ba16781.gif[/img]

[b]Hasta[/b]
A spear that keeps your enemies at a distance. While this weapon locks you in a direction, it can combine with the shield to offer extra protection. 

[b]Shield[/b]
A strong defence. Timing your blocks perfectly can stun enemies and give you a small damage boost.

[b]Daggers[/b]
Fast strikes at low damage, this weapon has been favored by those that seek to quickly take care of singled out foes, or prefer to attack distracted enemies.

[b]Hammers[/b]
A new form of weapon, granted by one of the yet to be revealed gods of the pantheon, allows for slow but heavy hits that knock back and stun weaker enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/7321d9d8648e302e8d526ed044e7952a3174ccfd.gif[/img]

[b]Pilum[/b]
A one time use thrown spear that inflicts heavy damage but must be wielded in the off hand.

[h2]The City Must Survive[/h2]
Offence is important, but when the Fallen end up on [i]your doorstep[/i] you'll need more than swords and armour to repent the vicious hordes.

[b]Traps[/b]
Why do all the heavy work yourself? Save some trouble and time by building automatic defences like coal pits or automatic ballistae to defend your town for you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/3393fdfe8db0c0532fab8009811cc31227dd18b8.gif[/img]

[b]Pots[/b]
Building the pottery allows you to craft special pots, filled to the brim with destructive intent! Throw them, shoot them, or strike them. The uses are endless for these capsules of chaos!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/eaaa04c50ee8df531d837f342e0a9110080cd09f.gif[/img]

[h2]The Alpha Is Nearly Upon Us[/h2]
The wait has been long, but it is finally (almost) over. 
Starting [b]mid next week[/b], we'll be opening the gates to our lovely world.
This will be happening gradually, and randomly. We do not control who gets access through steams system.

We once again want to remind you all that this is a [b]closed alpha playtest[/b] and that no sharing outside of the official [url=https://discord.gg/BDgRY2WFDS]Romestead Discord[/url] dedicated channels is allowed.

[h2]What We’re Working on Right Now[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New enemies[/b] - We've been adding a new couple of enemies for other regions in the game not covered by the Alpha playtest! While you may not see them, know that they'll be there....watching.
[*] [b]Town Raids[/b] - While we won't divulge how they'll work just yet, after this devlog you should know that defending your town is just as important as exploring the world.
[*] [b]Art Polish[/b] - Out with the old, in with the new! We're updating a lot of the art assets to look as crisp as possible!
[*] [b]Bug Fixes[/b] - It has to be done! We're taking out the big ones so you can focus on the small ones!
[/list]
- Fixed a bug that made every living creature hate birds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/c083f0640efcbdfb091a7a692ffdb2e88cd0edab.gif[/img]

[h1]Until Next Time[/h1]
Stay strong just a little while longer. Only a few days remain.

We will be back in two weeks with more information and behind the scenes!

Until then,
[b]Roma Aeterna[/b]

- the Beartwigs Team

notes.title: Devlog II: Life Finds a Way
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Romans![/b]
This week, we take a stroll into the wilds of Romestead and explore the beings that inhabit it.

Civilization may have been wiped out to near extinction during the cataclysmic fall of Rome, but life finds a way. The natural life of Romestead is thriving, so let’s lift some rocks and rustle some bushes to see what’s really going on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/8faca2ef78e28b7cf92a52451dfc65e6ed9b60b6.gif[/img]

[h2]A Living World[/h2]
In Romestead, life doesn’t stop just because you do. There’s predators and prey, all with their own agendas, constantly interacting. 

For example: 
Wolves will work together bring down enemies. Bears will fight to the death if you get close to their cubs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/adc909fbc0423dc02c066492ad677e546603457e.gif[/img]

But not all creatures are out for blood. On your journey, you’ll encounter plenty just trying to get by. 
Goats, Deer, and critters of all kinds litter the world - each with their own quirks and behaviors. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/711394aee573350e622300680bd6a51f72662ab8.gif[/img]

[h2]A Strange New World[/h2]
In the wake of the apocalypse, strange things have begun to roam the land.
Maybe you find your cart is suddenly missing some resources. Maybe a rock stares back.
Or maybe that bush you walked past... wasn't a bush at all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/55be5f64c41188682a99b50e86d6b1efe2ad5898.gif[/img]

[h2]Three Weeks From Now, Some of You Will Be Harvesting Your Crops[/h2]
[b]Imagine where you will be, and it will be so.[/b]
The time for the playtest is fast approaching! 

We’re kicking off things in [b]three weeks[/b], and there is still time to sign up on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1805320/Romestead/]Steam page[/url]. Playtest access via Steam will be [b]random[/b]. We cannot pick or choose who gets in. But don’t worry, you’re not just rolling the dice once.

[b]Here’s what to know:[/b][list][*] Keys will be distributed in [b]waves[/b]. If you don’t get in right away, you’re still in the running.
[*] We will also be giving out playtest keys [b]in our [url=https://discord.gg/BDgRY2WFDS]official Discord[/url][/b]. Be there.
[*] We will be testing a new [b]Steam feature[/b] that lets playtesters invite a friend.
[*] [b]All testing will be under NDA[/b]. That means no streaming, screenshots, recordings, or public discussions. Keep it in the Discord.
[/list]

[h2]What We’re Working on Right Now[/h2]
The team is working hard to get you an unforgettable playtest experience! Some things we’ve got going on right now are:
[list]
[*] [b]More Dungeons[/b] - Challenges Galore! We’re adding more dungeons and filling them with enemies for you to fight!
[*] [b]Group Spawns[/b] - Previously, you’d encounter enemies either one at a time or all at once - like ketchup. Now, you’ll be able to meet a horde of the Fallen, a herd of boars, a scout patrol of [strike][REDACTED][/strike], or why not a whole family of frogs?
[*] [b]Logistics[/b] - A town can't work without proper logistics! We set our best leather worker on making a fancy new tent, outfitted with everything you need to run a city!
[*] [b]Translations[/b] - You’ve asked for it, and we’re working on it! We’ve got a list of a few languages to be added. Want your language in? Let us know.
[*] Fixed a bug that would spawn an [i]ungodly [/i] amount of angry boars (placeholder art).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/ec906e5b87996aeff0376d1a92ec4c69d1e9c73f.png[/img]

[h2]Until Next Time[/h2]
Our legions grow stronger by the day. A big thank you to everyone who has wishlisted and signed up for the playtest already.

We will be back in two weeks with more information and behind the scenes!

Until then, 
[b]Roma Aeterna![/b]

- The Beartwigs Team

notes.title: Devlog I: Do Us a Favor
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Romans![/b]
Welcome to our first devblog from the team at Beartwigs! 🐻

We’ll be sharing these every other week, quick peeks into what we’re building, what’s changing, and what’s quietly getting weirder. Let’s begin.

[h2]You Came for Us. All 45,000 of you.[/h2]
When we revealed [i]Romestead[/i] at the Future Games Show, we hoped it would spark something. And judging by your response… it did.

There's not just a handful of you. You're a legion*.
 
[i]*(Technically several legions' worth[/i]🤓[i])[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/c4fc1bf051345c79a0efb3a8691fe299e1af3f76.gif[/img]

Over [b]45,000[/b] of you have wishlisted the game, with [b]20,000+[/b] signed up for the playtest. These aren’t just numbers. It's thousands of you curious about something we’re building. We don’t take that lightly.

So here’s what you’re walking into.

[h2]The Gods Are Real. If You Let Them Be.[/h2]
When Rome fell, the gods were forgotten. Their altars crumbled. With no one to worship them, their power vaned.

But silence isn’t death. Not for them.

One of the first buildings you’ll construct in [i]Romestead[/i] is the [b]Altar[/b], the gateway to divine reconnection. The gods have begun to stir again, reaching out in fragments.

[i]“You have called, and I have answered. I am Minerva, Goddess of Wisdom. My mind is clouded, but I see potential in you. There is work to be done.”

She’s the first to reach you. But not the only one.
Other gods are watching. And not all will be so kind.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/ed02ca1b02197cfd377079bd4fb48a11e4ed754d.png[/img]
You’ll give offerings at these altars, items tied to each god’s preference: cooked food, crafted gear, or materials from the hunt. These raise your [b]Worship Level[/b], unlocking new buildings, upgrades, decorations and occasionally… side effects.

[b]Worship shapes the world. Favor shapes you.[/b]

As you explore, fight, build, and grow, you gain experience in specific skills. That experience earns you [b]Favor Points[/b], which unlock god-specific [b]skills and abilities[/b].

One we’re having a lot of fun with right now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/543ba424866424079f67f4e2d98cf5ad0920da04.gif[/img]
[b]Shield Slam[/b] - [i]Dash straight into the horde with your shield raised. The heavier your armour, the harder they fall. Just look at them go.[/i]

[h2]A Word on the Playtest[/h2]
We know a lot of you are eager to jump in, and we’re excited to get you playing.

Playtesting is planned to begin [b]in about a month[/b]. If you’ve already signed up, you’re already on the list. If not, you can still sign up on the Steam page.

We’re taking our time because we want this to feel like Romestead, not just a prototype of it. Thanks for your patience. It’s going to be worth it.

[h2]Got a Question?[/h2]
We’ll be posting these every other week, and if there’s something you’re dying to know, tell us.

Drop your suggestions in the comments, and if one catches our eye, we might just build a whole devlog around it.

[h2]What We’re Working on Right Now[/h2]
We’re deep in playtest prep, building out systems and content across the board. This includes:
[list]
[*][b]Items &Treasure[/b] - new weapons, enchantments, decorations, and gear. If it glows, hums, or makes your house look cool, it’s going in.
[*][b]A New Boss[/b] - one of the playtest bosses is in development now. No spoilers, but something to keep [i]an eye[/i] out for in the future.
[*][b]The Ruined City[/b] - a late-game biome where Rome’s collapse is still visible, and still dangerous.
[*] Also fixed a bug where entering and exiting buildings too fast would sometimes teleport you to a random doorway somewhere in the world. That [i]should[/i] no longer happen.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549195/7c7ffd66ce4ebc2229c9bf4605432bdd19de7036.jpg[/img]

[h2]Until Next Time[/h2]
Thanks to everyone who’s wishlisted, signed up for the playtest, or joined the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FBDgRY2WFDS]Discord[/url].

We’ll be back in two weeks with more behind the scenes, maybe a new feature, maybe a mistake we’re still recovering from. Could go either way.

Until then…

Offer wisely.

[b]– The Beartwigs Team 🐻[/b]
